metadata.name: copy_vault
metadata.description: copy-vault: pump.fun coins whose creator fees fund an on-chain vault that copy-trades a target wallet

instructions.name: accept_admin
docs: The proposed admin takes over, after the timelock.

accounts.name: position
docs: bump once it exists); created by the program on the first buy.

accounts.name: authority
docs: The keeper, or anyone once the keeper heartbeat is older than `keeper_grace_secs` and the
target holds 0 (then in impact-capped slices, one per slot).

accounts.name: position
docs: `["position", copier.mint, token_mint]`: the open position being sold.

instructions.name: deposit
docs: Anyone adds capital (not profit) to a vault.

instructions.name: discard_pending
docs: Anyone closes a superseded or expired change (rent to its proposer).

instructions.name: execute_pending
docs: Anyone, once the change's timelock has passed.

accounts.name: copier
docs: The Index copier of an `IndexTargets` change (omit for other kinds).

instructions.name: fund_platform_burn
docs: Moves the copier's pending 25% profit share to the platform token burn pool.

instructions.name: initialize_config
docs: Once, by the program's upgrade authority: default params, the seeded venue whitelist, the
admin timelock (60 s – 7 days) and the funded platform-token burn pool.

accounts.name: program_data
docs: The program's ProgramData: only its upgrade authority (the deployer) can initialize.

accounts.name: burn_pool
docs: the platform token burn pool: system-owned, zero data; funded to rent here so it can receive any share.

instructions.name: keeper_heartbeat
docs: The keeper's liveness signal (every keeper-signed trade or burn also counts).

instructions.name: pause_keeper
docs: Instant: removes the keeper.

instructions.name: propose_descriptors
docs: Queues a venue whitelist change.

instructions.name: propose_index_targets
docs: Queues an Index copier's new target list.

instructions.name: propose_keeper
docs: Queues a keeper change (executable after the timelock).

instructions.name: propose_params
docs: Queues a parameter change (validated against the ranges now and at execution).

instructions.name: register_copier
docs: Last instruction of the launch tx: checks the fee-sharing split
`[target trader_bps, vault 10000 − trader_bps]` is final and creates the copier.

instructions.name: register_index
docs: Admin: an index copier (vault takes 100% of creator fees) copying up to 16 wallets.

instructions.name: set_platform_mint
docs: Once: names the registered Index copier whose coin is the platform token.

instructions.name: sync
docs: Books lamports that reached the vault without the program (creator fees) as fee income.

types.name: ChangeDiscarded
docs: A superseded or expired change's account was closed (`discard_pending`, permissionless).

types.name: ChangeInvalidated
docs: Change `id` can no longer execute (a newer proposal of its kind, a keeper pause or an admin
handover). Its account stays until `discard_pending` / `cancel_pending`.

types.name: ChangeProposed
docs: An admin change was queued (`propose_*`); executable by anyone from `eta` until `expires_at`
unless superseded first.

fields.name: platform_mint
docs: the platform token; `Pubkey::default()` until `set_platform_mint` (once).

fields.name: platform_burned
docs: the platform token tokens the burn pool bought and burned (`burn_platform`).

fields.name: platform_burn_spent
docs: Lamports the burn pool spent on those buys.

fields.name: timelock_secs
docs: Seconds between an admin proposal and its earliest execution (fixed at initialization).

fields.name: next_change_id
docs: Id of the next `PendingChange`.

fields.name: pending_admin_eta
docs: Earliest time `accept_admin` may run for `pending_admin`.

fields.name: keeper_heartbeat_ts
docs: Last keeper-signed instruction (any trade, burn or `keeper_heartbeat`).

fields.name: last_platform_burn_ts
docs: Last `burn_platform`.

fields.name: latest_change_ids
docs: Per `ChangeKind` (in enum order): the id of the only proposal of that kind that may
execute, or `NO_CHANGE`. A newer proposal supersedes the older one; `pause_keeper` clears the
Keeper entry, `accept_admin` clears all of them.

fields.name: descriptors_proven
docs: Bit i: `descriptors[i]` is proven (seeded, or a trade through it succeeded).

fields.name: verified
docs: Bit i set: targets[i] signed `verify_trader`.

fields.name: accounted_lamports
docs: Vault lamports + vault wSOL the program knows about; anything above is fee income (`sync`).

fields.name: open_cost
docs: Cost basis of all open positions (lamports, rent included).

fields.name: buyback_pool
docs: Earmarked for buying back & burning the copier's own coin (75% of profit above the HWM).

fields.name: platform_sent
docs: Lamports sent to the platform token burn pool (25% of profit above the HWM).

fields.name: burned
docs: Own-coin tokens bought back and burned.

fields.name: buyback_spent
docs: Lamports spent on own-coin buybacks.

fields.name: graduated_pool
docs: Canonical PumpSwap pool of the own coin once a buyback has seen it graduated.

fields.name: platform_pending
docs: the platform token share not yet moved to the burn pool (`fund_platform_burn`).

fields.name: target_positions
docs: Open positions per target index (parallel to `targets`).

fields.name: window_start
docs: Start of the current buy spend window.

fields.name: window_spent
docs: Lamports `copier_buy` spent in the current window.

fields.name: window_equity
docs: Equity at the start of the current window (the window cap's base).

fields.name: last_public_sell_slot
docs: Slot of the last permissionless `copier_sell` (one slice per slot).

fields.name: sol_in
docs: Lamports the buy cost the vault (venue spend plus any rent it paid), booked as cost.

fields.name: equity
docs: Vault equity before the buy.

fields.name: sol_out
docs: Lamports back on the vault: venue proceeds plus rent refunded on a closing sell.

fields.name: forced
docs: Exit by max-hold or by a non-keeper after the keeper grace period.

types.name: FeesSynced
docs: Lamports found on the vault that the program did not move itself (creator fees).

fields.name: total
docs: `fees_in` after booking.

types.name: KeeperPaused
docs: The admin removed the keeper instantly (`pause_keeper`); a new one needs a timelocked
`propose_keeper`.

types.name: Params
docs: Admin-settable trading parameters; `validate` enforces the two-sided ranges in
`constants.rs`. Changed only through the timelocked `propose_params` → `execute_pending`.

fields.name: max_trade_bps
docs: Max lamports per buy, in bps of vault equity.

fields.name: max_position_bps
docs: Max cost basis per traded mint, in bps of vault equity.

fields.name: min_signal_lamports
docs: Min (target token increase × spot price) for a buy to count as a signal.

fields.name: signal_multiple_bps
docs: A vault buy may spend at most this multiple (bps) of the signal.

fields.name: max_impact_bps
docs: Max lamports per buy in bps of the venue's real quote reserves.

fields.name: slippage_bps
docs: Program-side floor: fills must reach (10000 − slippage_bps) of the fee-free quote.

fields.name: vault_floor_lamports
docs: Free SOL a buy may never spend below.

fields.name: max_hold_secs
docs: After this long a position may be exited regardless of the target.

fields.name: keeper_grace_secs
docs: After this long without a keeper heartbeat (`Config.keeper_heartbeat_ts`), exits are
permissionless for positions whose target holds 0, in impact-capped slices.

fields.name: spend_window_secs
docs: Length of a copier's buy spend window.

fields.name: max_window_spend_bps
docs: Max lamports `copier_buy` may spend per window, in bps of equity at the window's start.

types.name: ParamsUpdated
docs: Any config change (params, keeper, descriptors, admin handover, the platform token mint).

types.name: PendingChange
docs: A timelocked admin change `["pending", id]`. Anyone may execute it from `eta` to `expires_at`
while it is still the live proposal of its kind (`Config.latest_change_ids[kind] == id`); a newer
proposal of the same kind, `pause_keeper` (Keeper changes) or `accept_admin` (all) supersede
it. Status for indexers: superseded if not the live id, expired after `expires_at`, queued
before `eta`, executable otherwise. The admin may cancel it; anyone may discard it once
superseded or expired. Only the payload field of its `kind` is meaningful.

fields.name: expires_at
docs: Last moment it can execute (`eta + EXECUTE_WINDOW_SECS`).

fields.name: copier
docs: The Index copier whose targets change (`IndexTargets`).

fields.name: mint
docs: The copier's mint.

fields.name: token_mint
docs: The traded coin.

fields.name: target
docs: The target this position copies.

fields.name: cost
docs: Cost basis (lamports spent, rent included).

fields.name: target_snapshot
docs: Target's balance after the last copied trade.

fields.name: target_peak
docs: Target's balance at the last vault buy; with `vault_peak` sets the proportional sell.

types.name: TradeDescriptor
docs: One whitelisted venue instruction. The keeper forwards that instruction's exact account list
as remaining accounts and its full data (discriminator included); the program checks the roles
below, signs as `remaining[user_idx]` and measures the fill from balance deltas.

fields.name: program
docs: pump or pump_amm only.
